Real official KiCad symbol library files, vendored as test fixtures for
`schematic/library.py`.

Source: https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-symbols, tag `9.0.9.1`
(last version using one `.kicad_sym` file per library, before the
per-symbol-file `.kicad_symdir` restructuring).
